acceptance: update_item with not_before set to an empty string clears the hold and the item is claimable immediately (test or live proof)
A documented way adds text to context or description without overwriting concurrent edits, or the replace-only behaviour is stated in the tool description
context: Seen while closing items held until 2026-11-02 after the calendar waits were waived: clearing with an empty string was accepted but the hold stayed. The note-prepend workaround reads then rewrites the whole context field.
description: update_item with not_before set to an empty string does not clear a hold, so an item held to a future date cannot be released early; the only workaround is to set not_before a few seconds ahead, wait, then take. update_item also replaces text fields wholesale, so adding a note to context requires reading the field and writing it back. Both cost extra steps and risk overwriting concurrent edits.
